sources.entry: django-rest-framework - A powerful and flexible toolkit to build web APIs.

summary.one_liner: Django REST framework is a toolkit for building Web APIs on top of Django, with a browsable API, serializers, authentication policies, and viewsets/routers.
summary.what_it_does: Provides serializers that work with both Django ORM models and plain (non-ORM) data sources. Offers authentication policy classes, with optional packages named for OAuth1a and OAuth2. Includes a web-browsable API that lets developers inspect and interact with endpoints in a browser. Supports class-based generic views and viewsets, plus routers that generate URL configuration automatically. Developers can also drop down to plain function-based views when they need full control. The README's example wires a User model into a read/write endpoint with a single viewset and router, and shows curl usage against it.
use_cases: build a JSON web API for a Django project
expose Django models as REST endpoints
add token or OAuth authentication to an API
browse and test API endpoints in a web browser
set model-level permissions on API access
how_to_run: Define serializers and viewsets, then register them with a router in urls.py
notable: Web-browsable API for developers to explore endpoints in a browser
Serializers support both ORM models and non-ORM data sources
Routers automatically generate URL configuration from viewsets
Use plain Django function-based views when the higher-level features are not needed
caveats: Officially supports only the latest patch release of each Python and Django series
Requires Django; it is an add-on toolkit, not standalone
